verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a SaaS search API, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of versioned API endpoints or a documented deprecation policy. The only deprecation mention is a GitHub notice that the legacy Python client library 'will soon be deprecated' in favor of serpapi-python. That notice covers an SDK, not the API, and gives no timeline or policy, so it does not show versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy.
